name: TALAMT
recent: TALAMT 于 2026 年 9 月完成一项私募配售，以每股 RM0.07 发行 118,190,000 股新股，并于 9 月 25 日上市。公司于 9 月 28 日举行第 101 届常年股东大会，所有 9 项决议均获通过。10 月初公司公告提供财务援助，具体细节未在资料中说明。
notable: 完成私募配售，以每股 RM0.07 发行 118,190,000 股新股，并于 2026 年 9 月 25 日上市。
第 101 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 28 日举行，所有 9 项决议均获股东通过。
公告提供财务援助，具体内容未在资料中说明。
risks: 私募配售发行 118,190,000 股新股，占已发行股份约 10%，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
大股东 MR ONG MUA KHEE 于 2026 年 9 月 25 日提交权益通知（第 137 条）。

recent_en: TALAMT completed a private placement in September 2026, issuing 118,190,000 new shares at RM0.07 each, which were listed on 25 September. The company held its 101st AGM on 28 September, where all nine resolutions were approved. In early October, the company announced the provision of financial assistance, with details not specified in the provided materials.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 118,190,000 new shares at RM0.07 per share, listed on 25 September 2026.
Held its 101st AGM on 28 September 2026, with all nine resolutions approved by shareholders.
Announced the provision of financial assistance, with details not specified in the materials.
risks_en: The private placement of 118,190,000 new shares, representing approximately 10% of issued shares, may dilute existing shareholders.
Substantial shareholder MR ONG MUA KHEE filed a notice of interest under Section 137 on 25 September 2026.
